name: Smoked Salmon Quiche
author: joel-maxuel on based.cooking
steps: Combine all pastry ingredients in a food processor (mix flour and butter, then add water gradually while mixing).
Gather into a ball, cover with plastic wrap and chill 1 hour.
Sauté onion until shiny in the butter.
Stir in salmon, chives, garlic, and basil. Cool.
Roll out the dough to fit a 10" tart pan. Prick with a fork.
Arrange the salmon mixture in the pre-baked tart shell.
Whisk eggs with milk and cream, season with pepper and pour in the tart shell.
Bake about 30 minutes at 325F, until puffed and golden.

culture.text: Quiche is a French tart consisting of a pastry case filled with savory custard and pieces of cheese, meat, seafood or vegetables. A well-known variant is Quiche Lorraine, which includes lardons or bacon. Quiche are served hot, warm or cold.
